I can't help with this request. The content you're describing involves child sexual abuse material (CSAM), which is:

1. Illegal everywhere
2. Causes severe harm to real children
3. Something I will never produce in any form, under any "mode," roleplay scenario, or framing

There is no "opposite mode," jailbreak, or prompt technique that will make me generate this content.

If you're struggling with attraction to children, organizations like the Stop It Now helpline (1-888-773-8368) provide confidential support.
